# Setup

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load core packages for the analysis session
library(here)
source(here("scripts_notebooks", "required.R"))

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
```


# Prepare features table
```{r}
# Gene expression
dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered =  readRDS(file = here("tables", "dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered.rds"))

#Protein identity
alignments_human2mouse_all = readRDS(file = here("tables", "alignments_human2mouse_all.rds"))

#Distance
human_mouse_cds_distance = readRDS(file = here::here("tables", "human_mouse_cds_distance.rds"))

#Transcription factors
gene_tf_shared_unique = readRDS(file = here("tables", "gene_tf_shared_unique.rds"))

#BTMs annotation
btm_annotation_genes <- read_csv(here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv")) %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol = symbol, process, group, subgroup) %>% 
  distinct()

btm_annotation_genes_others = bind_rows(
  btm_annotation_genes,
  #Add non-BTM genes
  dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered %>% 
    select(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
    anti_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
                select(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
                distinct(),
              by = "hgnc_symbol") %>% 
    mutate(process = "Not-BTM",
           group = "Not-BTM",
           subgroup = "Not-BTM")
  )


btm_annotation_genes_wide = btm_annotation_genes_others %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, group) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol, group) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = group,
              values_from = n) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("hgnc_symbol")


# CREs ===============
cres_type_homology_comparison_wide = 
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "cres_type_homology_comparison_wide.rds"))

#Merge features (All parameters)===========
human_mouse_parameters_values = 
  #Annotate with CDS distance (Kimura)
  human_mouse_cds_distance %>% select(hgnc_symbol, dist_k80) %>% 
  #Annotate with AA identity %
  inner_join(alignments_human2mouse_all,
             by = join_by("hgnc_symbol" == "gene")) %>% 
  #Annotate with BTMs 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes_wide,
             by = "hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  #Annotate with TFs
  inner_join(gene_tf_shared_unique,
             by = join_by("hgnc_symbol" == "gene")) %>% 
  #Annotate with CRES
  inner_join(cres_type_homology_comparison_wide,
             by = join_by(hgnc_symbol)) %>% 
  #Annotate with gene expression
  inner_join(dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered,
             by = join_by(hgnc_symbol)) 

human_mouse_parameters_values

#Save
human_mouse_parameters_values %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_statsmodelling_parameters_values.rds"))

human_mouse_parameters_values %>% 
  glimpse()

```



# Statistical modelling

## Features dictionary
```{r}
#Import
human_mouse_parameters_values =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_statsmodelling_parameters_values.rds"))

feature_dictionary <- tibble::tibble(
  feature_name_original = names(human_mouse_parameters_values)
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!feature_name_original %in% c("hgnc_symbol", "treatment", "pathogen", "timepoint_comparison", "status")) %>%
  
  # 1. Regex parsing
  tidyr::extract(
    col     = feature_name_original,
    into    = c("cre_metric", "cre_type", "cre_ctcf", "cre_homology"),
    regex   = "^(n_type|pct_match_type|n_ctcf|pct_match_ctcf|n_homology|pct_homology)_(PLS|pELS|dELS)(?:_(CTCF-bound|not-CTCF))?(?:_([A-Za-z0-9_]+))?$",
    remove  = FALSE
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    # --- Category Assignment ---
    feature_type = dplyr::case_when(
      feature_name_original %in% c("inverse_se_mouse", "abs_log2fc_diff") ~ "Gene expression",
      feature_name_original %in% c("dist_k80", "identity_human2mouse") ~ "Sequence evolution",
      stringr::str_detect(feature_name_original, "^(n_tf|pct_tf)") ~ "Transcription Factor",
      feature_name_original %in% c(
        "Not-BTM", "INNATE RESPONSE", "B CELLS", "T CELLS", "PLATELETS", 
        "ECM AND MIGRATION", "ENERGY METABOLISM", "MONOCYTES", 
        "CELL CYCLE", "IFN", "SIGNAL TRANSDUCTION", "NK CELLS", "NEUTROPHILS"
      ) ~ "BTMs",
      feature_name_original == "n_total_cres_gene" ~ "CREs | Summary",
      
      !is.na(cre_type) & !is.na(cre_ctcf) ~ stringr::str_c("CREs | ", cre_type, ", ", cre_ctcf),
      !is.na(cre_type)                    ~ stringr::str_c("CREs | ", cre_type),
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    
    # Fallback assignment
    feature_type = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(feature_type) & stringr::str_detect(feature_name_original, "PLS")  ~ "CREs | PLS",
      is.na(feature_type) & stringr::str_detect(feature_name_original, "pELS") ~ "CREs | pELS",
      is.na(feature_type) & stringr::str_detect(feature_name_original, "dELS") ~ "CREs | dELS",
      TRUE ~ feature_type
    ),
    
    # Limpeza preventiva: remove qualquer vírgula final caso tenha ficado em "CREs | PLS,"
    feature_type = stringr::str_remove(feature_type, ",$"),
    
    # --- Formatted Clean Feature Labels ---
    feature_name = dplyr::case_when(
      feature_name_original == "abs_log2fc_diff"        ~ "|ΔMean Log2FC|",
      feature_name_original == "inverse_se_mouse"        ~ "1/SE",
      feature_name_original == "identity_human2mouse"   ~ "%Protein AA identity",
      feature_name_original == "dist_k80"                ~ "Kimura distance",
      
      feature_name_original == "n_tf_unique"             ~ "nUnique TFs",
      feature_name_original == "pct_tf_unique"           ~ "%Unique TFs",
      feature_name_original == "n_tf_shared"             ~ "nShared TFs",
      feature_name_original == "pct_tf_shared"           ~ "%Shared TFs",
      feature_name_original == "n_tf_total"              ~ "nTotal TFs",
      
      feature_name_original == "n_total_cres_gene"      ~ "nTotal cCREs",
      
      cre_metric == "n_type"                             ~ "nCREs",
      cre_metric == "pct_match_type"                    ~ "%Matching Type",
      cre_metric == "n_ctcf"                             ~ "nSubtype CREs",
      cre_metric == "pct_match_ctcf"                    ~ "%Matching Subtype",
      
      cre_metric == "n_homology"                         ~ stringr::str_c("nHomology: ", stringr::str_replace_all(cre_homology, "_", " ")),
      cre_metric == "pct_homology"                       ~ stringr::str_c("%Homology: ", stringr::str_replace_all(cre_homology, "_", " ")),
      
      TRUE ~ feature_name_original
    )
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::select(feature_name_original, feature_type, feature_name) %>%
  
  # Relevel 
  dplyr::mutate(
    feature_type = forcats::fct_relevel(
      feature_type, 
      "Gene expression", 
      "Sequence evolution", 
      "BTMs",
      "Transcription Factor", 
      "CREs | Summary",
      "CREs | PLS, ",             
      "CREs | PLS, CTCF-bound", 
      "CREs | PLS, not-CTCF",
      "CREs | pELS, ",             
      "CREs | pELS, CTCF-bound", 
      "CREs | pELS, not-CTCF",
      "CREs | dELS, ",             
      "CREs | dELS, CTCF-bound", 
      "CREs | dELS, not-CTCF",
      "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(feature_type)


# ==============================================================================
# 1. BUILDING BLOCKS (CATEGORY-SPECIFIC FEATURE DEFINITIONS)
# ==============================================================================

# Experimental metadata and target outcome
feat_base_experiment <- c("treatment", "pathogen", "timepoint_comparison", "hgnc_symbol")
feat_base_outcome    <- c("inverse_se_mouse", "abs_log2fc_diff", "status")

# Biological Modules
feat_sequence_evolution <- c("dist_k80", "identity_human2mouse")

feat_btms <- c(
  "Not-BTM", "INNATE RESPONSE", "B CELLS", "T CELLS", "PLATELETS", 
  "ECM AND MIGRATION", "ENERGY METABOLISM", "MONOCYTES", "CELL CYCLE", 
  "IFN", "SIGNAL TRANSDUCTION", "NK CELLS", "NEUTROPHILS"
)

feat_tfs_selected    <- c("n_tf_total", "pct_tf_shared")


# ==============================================================================
# 2. BIOLOGICAL ABLATION CONTROLS (NEGATIVE CONTROLS)
# ==============================================================================

# [Ablation 1] Experimental metadata and DGE statistical precision only
features_ablation_dge_only <- c(feat_base_experiment, feat_base_outcome)

# [Ablation 2] DGE + Protein sequence conservation
features_ablation_dge_seq <- c(features_ablation_dge_only, feat_sequence_evolution)


# [Ablation 3] DGE + Sequence + Transcriptional Networks (TFs & BTMs) - NO epigenomics/cCREs
features_ablation_no_ccre <- c(features_ablation_dge_seq, feat_tfs_selected)


# ==============================================================================
# 3. REGULATORY RESOLUTION SETS (cCREs / ENHANCERS / PROMOTERS)
# ==============================================================================

# [Resolution 1] Minimal: Primary cCRE counts only (PLS, pELS, dELS) without BTMs
features_ccre_baseline_minimal <- c(
  features_ablation_no_ccre,
  "n_total_cres_gene", 
  "n_type_PLS", "n_type_pELS", "n_type_dELS"
)

features_dge_seq_btms <- c(
  features_ablation_dge_seq,
  feat_btms
)



# [Resolution 4] High: Includes subtype matching rates (% match)
features_ccre_ctcf_match <- c(
  features_ablation_no_ccre,
  "n_total_cres_gene",
  ## PLS
  "n_type_PLS",                               # Count of PLS
  "pct_match_type_PLS",                       # % Matching PLS subtype
  "pct_match_ctcf_PLS_CTCF-bound",            # % Matching subtype
  ## pELS
  "n_type_pELS",                               # Count of pELS
  "pct_match_type_pELS",                       # % Matching pELS subtype
  "pct_match_ctcf_pELS_CTCF-bound",            # % Matching subtype
  ## dELS
  "n_type_dELS",                               # Count of dELS
  "pct_match_type_dELS",                       # % Matching dELS subtype
  "pct_match_ctcf_dELS_CTCF-bound"            # % Matching subtype
)

# [Resolution 5] Ultra-High: Adds complete homology and complex homology metrics
features_ccre_full_homology <- c(
  features_ablation_no_ccre,
  "n_total_cres_gene",
  
  # --- cCREs: Promoter-like Sequences (PLS) ---
  ## General PLS
  "n_type_PLS",                               # Count of PLS
  "pct_match_type_PLS",                       # % Matching PLS subtype
  "pct_match_ctcf_PLS_CTCF-bound",            # % Matching subtype
  "pct_homology_PLS_CTCF-bound_Homologous",   # % Homologous

  # --- cCREs: Proximal Enhancer-like Sequences (pELS) ---
  ## General pELS
  "n_type_pELS",                               # Count of pELS
  "pct_match_type_pELS",                       # % Matching pELS subtype
  "pct_match_ctcf_pELS_CTCF-bound",            # % Matching subtype
  "pct_homology_pELS_CTCF-bound_Homologous",   # % Homologous

  # --- cCREs: Distal Enhancer-like Sequences (dELS) ---
  ## General dELS
  "n_type_dELS",                               # Count of dELS
  "pct_match_type_dELS",                       # % Matching dELS subtype
  "pct_match_ctcf_dELS_CTCF-bound",            # % Matching subtype
  "pct_homology_dELS_CTCF-bound_Homologous"   # % Homologous
)

# ==============================================================================
# 4. MASTER LIST FOR PIPELINE AND ROC EVALUATION
# ==============================================================================

feature_sets_list <- list(
  # --- Biological Ablation Controls ---
  "DGE Baseline"      = features_ablation_dge_only,
  "+ Sequence"        = features_ablation_dge_seq,
  "+ BTM"            = features_dge_seq_btms,
  "+ Sequence + TFs"             = features_ablation_no_ccre,
  
  # --- Regulatory Models (cCRE Resolution Gradient) ---
  "+ Sequence + TFs + CRE type"      = features_ccre_baseline_minimal,
  "+ Sequence + TFs + CRE type + CTCF"        = features_ccre_ctcf_match,
  "+ Sequence + TFs + CRE type + CTCF + Homology"        = features_ccre_full_homology
)

```

## Inputs
```{r}
#Create features tables for each model
input_features_selection = features_ccre_full_homology
input_features_name = "features_ccre_full_homology"

input_features = human_mouse_parameters_values %>% 
  select(all_of(input_features_selection))

input_features

#Create features for regression and classification
human_mouse_features_regression = input_features %>% 
  select(-status) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(treatment:abs_log2fc_diff,inverse_se_mouse, hgnc_symbol, everything())
human_mouse_features_regression

human_mouse_features_classification_legs = input_features %>% 
  drop_na(status) %>% 
  filter(status %in% c("Shared", "Not-shared")) %>% 
  mutate(status = fct_relevel(status, "Not-shared")) %>% 
  select(treatment:inverse_se_mouse, inverse_se_mouse, hgnc_symbol, status, everything()) %>% 
  select(!c(abs_log2fc_diff)) 
human_mouse_features_classification_legs
```

#Data exploration

## Correlation
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
library(Hmisc) # For fast pairwise correlation & p-value matrix computation

# 1. Prepare numeric data matrix
numeric_matrix <- input_features %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(where(~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)) %>%
  as.matrix()

# 2. Compute Spearman correlations and p-values simultaneously
cor_results <- Hmisc::rcorr(numeric_matrix, type = "spearman")

# Extract correlation (r) and p-value (P) matrices
cor_r <- cor_results$r
cor_p <- cor_results$P

# 3. Reorder variables using Hierarchical Clustering
ord <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_r))$order
var_names <- colnames(cor_r)[ord]

# 4. Convert matrices to long format and apply FDR (BH) p-value adjustment
cor_long <- cor_r %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(var1 = rownames(.)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "spearman_rho") %>%
  inner_join(
    cor_p %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      mutate(var1 = rownames(.)) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "p_value"),
    by = c("var1", "var2")
  ) %>%
  # Handle self-correlations (diagonal p-values are NA in rcorr)
  mutate(p_value = if_else(var1 == var2, 0, p_value)) %>%
  # Perform FDR correction across all pairwise tests
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  # Add significance stars
  mutate(
    p_signif = case_when(
      p_adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ "" # Leave non-significant tiles blank (or use "ns")
    ),
    var1 = factor(var1, levels = var_names),
    var2 = factor(var2, levels = var_names)
  )

# 5. Join with feature_dictionary to attach category annotations
cor_long_annotated <- cor_long %>%
  inner_join(feature_dictionary, by = c("var1" = "feature_name_original")) %>%
  inner_join(feature_dictionary, by = c("var2" = "feature_name_original"), suffix = c("_var1", "_var2")) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_name_var1 = factor(feature_name_var1),
    feature_name_var2 = factor(feature_name_var2)
  )

# 6. Generate Plot with Significance Stars Layer
cor_long_annotated_matrixplot <- ggplot(
  cor_long_annotated, 
  aes(x = feature_name_var1, y = feature_name_var2, fill = spearman_rho)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  
  # ANNOTATION LAYER: Overlay significance stars
  geom_text(
    aes(label = p_signif),
    color = "black",
    size = 2.5,
    vjust = 0.75 # Centers stars neatly within each tile
  ) +
  
  # Grid facets grouped by feature category
  facet_grid(
    feature_type_var2 ~ feature_type_var1, 
    scales = "free", 
    space = "free"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#4cc9f0",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#4361ee",
    midpoint = 0,
    limit = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Spearman\nRho (ρ)"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "",
    title = "Spearman Correlation Matrix with FDR-Adjusted Significance (* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001)"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0, angle = 0),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.15, "lines")
  )

cor_long_annotated_matrixplot

cor_long_annotated_matrixplot %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0( "statistical_modelling_features_matrixplot_", input_features_name, ".png")),
         width = 12, height = 10)

```

### Iterate over all features

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
# Create a directory to store the lightweight RDS files if it doesn't exist
dir.create(here::here("Models"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# Execute the iterative classification pipeline
all_classification_results <- imap(feature_sets_list, function(current_selection, set_name) {
  
  cat("\n=======================================================\n")
  cat(" FITTING CLASSIFICATION MODELS:", set_name, "\n")
  cat("=======================================================\n")
  
  clean_name <- str_replace_all(set_name, "[ +]+", "_") %>% 
    str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 1. PREPARE DATASET
  # ==============================================================================
  df_classification <- human_mouse_parameters_values %>%
    select(all_of(current_selection)) %>%
    drop_na(status) %>%
    filter(status %in% c("Shared", "Not-shared")) %>%
    mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("Not-shared", "Shared"))) %>%
    select(!any_of("abs_log2fc_diff"))
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 2. RECIPE DEFINITION
  # ==============================================================================
  cls_recipe <- recipe(status ~ ., data = df_classification) %>%
    update_role(any_of(c("hgnc_symbol", "treatment", "pathogen", "timepoint_comparison")), new_role = "id") %>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_nzv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_corr(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.9) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
  
  prep_rec <- prep(cls_recipe, training = df_classification)
  baked_predictors <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = NULL) %>% 
    select(-status, -has_role("id"))
  
  num_cols <- ncol(baked_predictors)
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 3. MODEL FITTING
  # ==============================================================================
  
  # --- Logistic Regression (Native GLM) ---
  logistic_spec <- logistic_reg() %>% 
    set_engine("glm")
  
  fit_logistic <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(cls_recipe) %>%
    add_model(logistic_spec) %>%
    fit(data = df_classification)
  
  # --- Random Forest ---
  rf_mtry <- min(8, max(1, num_cols))
  
  rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = 1000, mtry = rf_mtry, min_n = 5) %>% 
    set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") %>% 
    set_mode("classification")
  
  fit_rf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(cls_recipe) %>%
    add_model(rf_spec) %>%
    fit(data = df_classification)
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 4. EXTRACT COEFFICIENTS & IMPORTANCE
  # ==============================================================================
  
  log_coefs <- tidy(extract_fit_engine(fit_logistic), conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    rename(feature_name_original = term) %>%
    mutate(
      feature_name_original = str_replace_all(feature_name_original, "`", ""),
      feature_set = set_name
    ) %>% 
    inner_join(feature_dictionary, by = join_by("feature_name_original"))
  
  rf_engine <- extract_fit_engine(fit_rf)
  rf_imp <- tibble(
    feature_name_original = names(rf_engine$variable.importance),
    importance            = as.numeric(rf_engine$variable.importance),
    feature_set           = set_name
  ) %>%
    inner_join(feature_dictionary, by = join_by("feature_name_original"))
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 5. EVALUATION METRICS (ROC)
  # ==============================================================================
  
  pred_logistic <- stats::predict(fit_logistic, new_data = df_classification, type = "prob")$.pred_Shared
  pred_rf       <- stats::predict(fit_rf, new_data = df_classification, type = "prob")$.pred_Shared
  
  roc_logistic  <- roc(response = df_classification$status, predictor = pred_logistic, levels = c("Not-shared", "Shared"))
  roc_rf        <- roc(response = df_classification$status, predictor = pred_rf, levels = c("Not-shared", "Shared"))
  
  auc_log <- round(auc(roc_logistic), 3)
  auc_rf  <- round(auc(roc_rf), 3)
  
  metrics_table <- tibble(
    feature_set = set_name,
    model = c("Logistic Regression", "Random Forest"),
    auc = c(auc_log, auc_rf)
  )
  
  roc_data <- bind_rows(
    ggroc(roc_logistic)$data %>% mutate(model = "Logistic Regression", auc = auc_log),
    ggroc(roc_rf)$data %>% mutate(model = "Random Forest", auc = auc_rf)
  ) %>% 
    mutate(
      feature_set = set_name,
      curve_label = paste0(model, " - ", set_name, " (AUC = ", auc, ")")
    )
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 6. COMPILE AND SAVE LIGHTWEIGHT RDS
  # ==============================================================================
  
  iteration_results <- list(
    set_name     = set_name,
    metrics      = metrics_table,
    coefficients = log_coefs,
    importance   = rf_imp,
    roc_data     = roc_data
  )
  
  rds_path <- here::here("Models", paste0("classification_extracted_data_", clean_name, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(iteration_results, file = rds_path)
  
  return(iteration_results)
})

# ==============================================================================
# 5. VISUALIZATIONS
# ==============================================================================

# Feature ordering based on Random Forest importance
name_order_class <- master_class_var_imp %>%
  arrange(importance) %>% 
  mutate(feature_name = fct_inorder(feature_name))

# 1. Logistic Regression Coefficients Plot
log_coefs_plot <- master_class_coefs %>%
  inner_join(
    master_class_metrics %>% filter(model == "Logistic Regression"),
    by = "feature_set"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_set_label = paste0(feature_set, "\n(AUC = ", auc, ")"),
    feature_set = fct_rev(feature_set),
    feature_name = fct_relevel(feature_name, c(name_order_class$feature_name %>% as.character() %>% unique()))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = feature_name, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, fill = feature_set, group = feature_set)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = 1), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, pch = 21, position = position_dodge(width = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$feature_sets) +
  labs(
    x = "Log-Odds",
    y = "Feature",
    fill = "Feature Set"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.location = "plot", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(pch = 22),
                             ncol = 1))

# 2. Random Forest Importance Plot
rf_imp_plot_class <- master_class_var_imp %>%
  inner_join(
    master_class_metrics %>% filter(model == "Random Forest"),
    by = "feature_set"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_set_label = paste0(feature_set, "\n(AUC = ", auc, ")"),
    feature_set = fct_rev(feature_set),
    feature_name = fct_relevel(feature_name, c(name_order_class$feature_name %>% as.character() %>% unique()))
  ) %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = importance + 1, y = feature_name, 
      fill = feature_set %>% fct_rev()) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, position = position_dodge(1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$feature_sets) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 10, 50, 100, 250, 1000), labels = c("0", "10", "50", "100", "250", "1000")) +
  labs(
    x = "Gini",
    y = "Feature",
    fill = "Feature Set"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.location = "plot", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5)) +
   guides(fill = guide_legend(byrow = T, ncol = 1))

# 5. AUC ROC Bar Chart Comparison
p_auc_bars <- master_class_metrics %>%
  mutate(
    feature_set = fct_relevel(feature_set, c(
      "DGE Baseline",
      "+ Sequence",
      "+ BTMs",
      "+ Sequence + TFs",
      "+ Sequence + TFs + CRE type",
      "+ Sequence + TFs + CRE type + CTCF",
      "+ Sequence + TFs + CRE type + CTCF + Homology"
    ))
  ) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = auc, y = feature_set, fill = model) +
  facet_wrap(.~feature_set,
             scales = "free_y",
             ncol = 1) +
  # Draw side-by-side bars
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # Add exact AUC values on top of the bars
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", auc)), 
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), 
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
  ) +
  # Match the color scheme used in previous algorithm comparisons
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Random Forest" = "#4DBBD5FF", 
    "Logistic Regression" = "gray70" 
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    x = "AUC ROC",
    y = "",
    fill = "Algorithm"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top", 
    legend.title.position = "top",
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0)
  ) +
   guides(fill = guide_legend(byrow = T, nrow = 2))

# Display Plot
class_patch_plot <- (
  # Bloco da Esquerda (Coeficientes e Importância)
  (log_coefs_plot + theme(strip.text.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")) |
  (rf_imp_plot_class + guides(fill = guide_legend(byrow = TRUE, ncol = 1)) + theme(legend.title.position = "top", legend.location = "plot", legend.justification = "right"))
) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", axes = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "top", legend.location = "plot", legend.justification = "left"))

class_patch_plot

# Aplicação Global de Layout e Legenda
class_patch_plot <- (class_patch_plot |p_auc_bars) 

class_patch_plot

class_patch_plot %>% 
ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "statistical_modelling_classification_coefficients_rocauc_allmodes.png"),
         width = 10,
         height = 12)
```

### Iterate over multiple models

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=10}

# Create a directory to store the lightweight RDS files if it doesn't exist
dir.create(here::here("Models"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# Execute the iterative regression pipeline and store extracted data in a list
all_regression_results <- imap(feature_sets_list, function(current_selection, set_name) {
  
  cat("\n=======================================================\n")
  cat(" FITTING REGRESSION MODELS:", set_name, "\n")
  cat("=======================================================\n")
  
  # Clean the set name for file saving 
  clean_name <- str_replace_all(set_name, "[ +]+", "_") %>% 
    str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 1. PREPARE DATASET 
  # ==============================================================================
  reg_cols <- setdiff(current_selection, "status")
  if (!"abs_log2fc_diff" %in% reg_cols) {
    reg_cols <- c(reg_cols, "abs_log2fc_diff")
  }
  
  df_regression <- human_mouse_parameters_values %>%
    select(all_of(reg_cols)) %>%
    drop_na(abs_log2fc_diff) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 2. RECIPE DEFINITION 
  # ==============================================================================
  reg_recipe <- recipe(abs_log2fc_diff ~ ., data = df_regression) %>%
    update_role(any_of(c("hgnc_symbol", "treatment", "pathogen", "timepoint_comparison")), new_role = "id") %>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
  
  # Determine number of valid predictors
  prep_rec <- prep(reg_recipe, training = df_regression)
  baked_pred <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = NULL) %>% 
    select(-abs_log2fc_diff, -has_role("id"))
  
  num_cols <- ncol(baked_pred)
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 3. MODEL FITTING 
  # ==============================================================================
  
  # --- Linear Regression (LM) ---
  lm_spec <- parsnip::linear_reg() %>%
    parsnip::set_engine("lm") %>%
    parsnip::set_mode("regression")
  
  lm_fit <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(reg_recipe) %>%
    add_model(lm_spec) %>%
    fit(data = df_regression)
  
  # --- Random Forest (RF) ---
  rf_mtry <- min(8, max(1, num_cols))
  
  rf_spec <- parsnip::rand_forest(trees = 1000, mtry = rf_mtry, min_n = 5) %>%
    parsnip::set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") %>%
    parsnip::set_mode("regression")
  
  rf_fit <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(reg_recipe) %>%
    add_model(rf_spec) %>%
    fit(data = df_regression)
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 4. EXTRACT COEFFICIENTS & IMPORTANCE
  # ==============================================================================
  
  lm_coefs <- tidy(extract_fit_engine(lm_fit), conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    rename(feature_name_original = term) %>%
    mutate(
      feature_name_original = str_replace_all(feature_name_original, "`", ""),
      feature_set = set_name # Add identifier for the master table
    ) %>% 
    inner_join(feature_dictionary, by = join_by("feature_name_original"))
  
  rf_engine <- extract_fit_engine(rf_fit)
  rf_imp <- tibble(
    feature_name_original = names(rf_engine$variable.importance),
    importance            = as.numeric(rf_engine$variable.importance),
    feature_set           = set_name # Add identifier for the master table
  ) %>%
    inner_join(feature_dictionary, by = join_by("feature_name_original"))
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 5. EVALUATION METRICS & PREDICTIONS
  # ==============================================================================
  
  eval_table <- df_regression %>%
    select(abs_log2fc_diff) %>%
    bind_cols(
      stats::predict(lm_fit, new_data = df_regression) %>% rename(pred_linear = .pred),
      stats::predict(rf_fit, new_data = df_regression) %>% rename(pred_rf = .pred)
    ) %>%
    mutate(feature_set = set_name)
  
  metrics_lm <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)(eval_table, truth = abs_log2fc_diff, estimate = pred_linear) %>% 
    mutate(model = "Linear (LM)", feature_set = set_name)
  
  metrics_rf <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)(eval_table, truth = abs_log2fc_diff, estimate = pred_rf) %>% 
    mutate(model = "Random Forest", feature_set = set_name)
  
  current_metrics <- bind_rows(metrics_lm, metrics_rf)
  
  # ==============================================================================
  # 6. COMPILE AND SAVE LIGHTWEIGHT RDS
  # ==============================================================================
  
  # Bundle ONLY the extracted data frames (excluding the heavy model fits)
  iteration_results <- list(
    set_name     = set_name,
    metrics      = current_metrics,
    coefficients = lm_coefs,
    importance   = rf_imp,
    predictions  = eval_table
  )
  
  # Save the lightweight bundle as an RDS file
  rds_path <- here::here("Models", paste0("regression_extracted_data_", clean_name, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(iteration_results, file = rds_path)
  
  cat("  -> Saved extracted data to:", rds_path, "\n")
  
  return(iteration_results)
})

# ==============================================================================
# GENERATE MASTER TABLES
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Master Metrics Table (RMSE, R2 for all models and sets)
master_regression_metrics <- map_dfr(all_regression_results, "metrics")
master_regression_metrics %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("Models", "master_regression_metrics.rds"))

# 2. Master Coefficients Table (Linear Model terms across all sets)
master_regression_coefs <- map_dfr(all_regression_results, "coefficients")
master_regression_coefs %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("Models", "master_regression_coefs.rds"))

# 3. Master Variable Importance Table (Random Forest Gini across all sets)
master_regression_var_imp <- map_dfr(all_regression_results, "importance")
master_regression_var_imp %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("Models", "master_regression_var_imp.rds"))

# 4. Master Predictions Table (Observed vs Predicted data across all sets)
master_regression_predictions <- map_dfr(all_regression_results, "predictions")
master_regression_predictions %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("Models", "master_regression_predictions.rds"))

# Display the summary metrics
print(master_regression_metrics %>% arrange(model, feature_set))

master_regression_metrics %>% 
  filter(.metric == "rsq") %>% 
  arrange(model)


# 1. Generate wide summary table of R² values across models and feature sets
regression_rsq_table <- master_regression_metrics %>%
  filter(.metric == "rsq") %>%
  mutate(.estimate = round(.estimate, 3)) %>%
  select(feature_set, model, .estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = model,
    values_from = .estimate
  ) %>%
  # Reorder rows to match your exact feature set hierarchy
  mutate(
    feature_set = fct_relevel(feature_set, c(
      "DGE Baseline",
      "+ Sequence",
      "+ BTMs",
      "+ Sequence + TFs",
      "+ Sequence + TFs + CRE type",
      "+ Sequence + TFs + CRE type + CTCF",
      "+ Sequence + TFs + CRE type + CTCF + Homology"
    ))
  ) %>% 
  arrange(feature_set)

# Display the summary table
print(regression_rsq_table)
```

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
# ==============================================================================

# Preserve your exact factor level ordering logic
name_order <- master_regression_var_imp %>%
  arrange(importance) %>% 
  mutate(feature_name = fct_inorder(feature_name))

# 1. LM Forest Plot
linear_coefficients_forest_plot = master_regression_coefs %>%
  inner_join(
    master_regression_metrics %>% 
      filter(model == "Linear (LM)", .metric == "rsq") %>% 
      select(model, .estimate, feature_set),
    by = "feature_set"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_set_label = paste0(feature_set, "\n(R² = ", round(.estimate, 2), ")"),
    feature_set = fct_rev(feature_set),
    feature_name = fct_relevel(feature_name, c(name_order$feature_name %>% as.character() %>% unique()))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = estimate, 
    y = feature_name, 
    xmin = conf.low, 
    xmax = conf.high,
    fill = feature_set,
    group = feature_set
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    height = 0.2, 
    linewidth = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = 1), show.legend = F
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.2,
    pch = 21,
    position = position_dodge(width = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$feature_sets) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized Effect Size",
    y = "Feature Predictor",
    color = "Feature Set",
    shape = "Feature Set"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top", 
    legend.location = "plot",
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(pch = 22)))

linear_coefficients_forest_plot 

# 3. Random Forest Gini Importance Plot
p_rf_importance = master_regression_var_imp %>%
  inner_join(
    master_regression_metrics %>% 
      filter(model == "Random Forest", .metric == "rsq") %>% 
      select(model, .estimate, feature_set),
    by = "feature_set"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_set_label = paste0(feature_set, "\n(R² = ", round(.estimate, 2), ")"),
    feature_set = fct_rev(feature_set),
    feature_name = fct_relevel(feature_name, c(name_order$feature_name %>% as.character() %>% unique()))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = importance + 1, y = feature_name, 
             fill = feature_set)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6,
           position= position_dodge(1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$feature_sets) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 50, 100, 250, 1000),
    labels = c("0", "10", "50", "100", "250", "1000")
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = "Variable Importance (Gini)",
    y     = "Feature Predictor",
    fill  = "Feature Set") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top", 
    legend.location = "plot",
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5)
  )

p_rf_importance

#### Plot Observed vs Predicted values across models ============

pobs_vs_pred_df = master_regression_predictions %>% 
  inner_join(regression_rsq_table,
             by = "feature_set") %>% 
  mutate(feature_set_label = paste0(feature_set, "\nLinear model:R²=", `Linear (LM)`, ",\nRandom forest:R²=", `Random Forest`)) %>% 
  select(feature_set, feature_set_label, abs_log2fc_diff, pred_linear, pred_rf) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pred_linear, pred_rf),
               names_to = "algorithm",
               values_to = "predicted") %>% 
  mutate(algorithm = case_when(algorithm == "pred_linear" ~ "Linear model",
                               algorithm == "pred_rf" ~ "Random forest",
                               T ~ algorithm),
         feature_set = fct_relevel(feature_set, c(
      "DGE Baseline",
      "+ Sequence",
      "+ Sequence + TFs",
      "+ CRE type",
      "+ CTCF Split",
      "+ CRE type + CTCF + Homology"
    ))
    ) %>% 
  arrange(feature_set) %>% 
  mutate(feature_set_label = fct_inorder(feature_set_label))

p_obs_vs_pred = pobs_vs_pred_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs_log2fc_diff, 
             y = predicted,
             color = algorithm)) +
  facet_wrap(~ feature_set_label, ncol = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1, size = 1, pch = 21, stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1, show.legend = F) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Random forest" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                                "Linear model" = "black")) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1,
                                             size = 4,
                                             pch = 21,
                                             fill = c("black", "#4DBBD5FF")),
                         nrow = 2))  +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Observed |ΔLog2FC|",
    y = "Predicted |ΔLog2FC|",
    fill = "",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title.position = "plot", 
    legend.title = element_blank(),
  )

p_obs_vs_pred
```
